scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @lowquo/surface-playground
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w @lowquo/surface-playground
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @lowquo/surface-playground
scripts.release:check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check:pack && npm run release:dry-run
